title: Transport of normalized scalar tensor comparisons to section modules
statement: Let a be a morphism of commutative condensed rings and T a scheme. Given a SectionScalarComparison s satisfying SectionScalarNormalized and a TensorNormalization t satisfying TensorNormalized, the same s and t satisfy SectionTensorNormalized a T s t. These are the exact predicates of [def-sfb-internal-section-scalar-pullback-comparison-data], [def-sfb-section-scalar-tensor-normalization-data] and [def-sfb-internal-derived-scalar-comparisons]. No flatness of a or cohomological bound is assumed.

proof.text: Conjugate the ordinary internal tensor normalization by s.ordinary, s.restriction and the section tensor equivalence. Cancel precomposition by the exact section equivalence using Mathlib Equivalence.congrLeft. The coequalizer generator calculation and symmetry give x tensor z on every internal image, and ordinary naturality transports it to any section module.

Conjugate the supplied derived tensor normalization by s.derived, sectionScalarRestriction and tensorComparison. The same equivalence cancellation constructs the derived section isomorphism. Cancellation of the inverse factors proves the final conjugation equation directly, without resolutions.

Apply the conjugated K-flat computation theorem to the constructed ordinary and derived isomorphisms and their proved generator and conjugation equations. These witnesses give SectionTensorNormalized.
